listing.name: Armour Visualiser
listing.summary: does what it says on the tin. (and also weapon arcs) updated for .98, no crashes afaik, yell at me if it does
listing.aiSummary: Visualises ship armour coverage, weapon firing arcs, and escort package ranges.

description: Displays a grid overlay on ships to show armour coverage and visualises weapon firing arcs. It also includes a visualiser for escort package range, with keybinds configurable in the LunaSettings menu.
